records.title: Science, Evidence and Health: Mastering Health Information and Personal Health Technologies
records.header: NMETH 210 Science, Evidence and Health: Mastering Health Information and Personal Health Technologies (4/5) SSc/NSc, DIV
records.text: NMETH 210 Science, Evidence and Health: Mastering Health Information and Personal Health Technologies (4/5) SSc/NSc, DIV Provides foundations for becoming skilled consumers of health information and health technologies. Using current topics in health, students will learn to navigate the available health information, understand its quality, become familiar with personal health technologies, and link information learned to their health and the health of their communities. Offered: W.

records.header: NMETH 419 Application of Methods for Research and Inquiry in Nursing (2)
records.text: NMETH 419 Application of Methods for Research and Inquiry in Nursing (2) Apply methods for contributing to evidence relevant to nursing. records.title: Informatics, Patient Safety, and Quality Improvement
records.header: NMETH 450 Informatics, Patient Safety, and Quality Improvement (3)
records.text: NMETH 450 Informatics, Patient Safety, and Quality Improvement (3) Explores concepts of the patient safety, quality and cost-effectiveness of health care, root cause analysis, and use of information technologies that promote quality and safety. Culminates in the design, implementation and evaluation of a small test of change with presentation of findings. Prerequisite: NMETH 403 or ABSN status; recommended: NMETH 403 ABSN status
